headline: Meta's Muse AI agent can now chat with users in Instagram DMs
body: Instagram users can now chat with Meta’s AI agent Muse in a DM thread, the company announced on Tuesday. Users can share posts with Muse and ask it to take action, such as finding a Black Friday deal on a pair of shoes. Muse in Instagram DMs will begin rolling out on Tuesday for iOS and Android users in the U.S., Canada, Mexico, Japan and Singapore.
note: Singapore is among the launch markets, and the open question for payment firms there is how an assistant inside a social app handles requests that involve money.
